scope: Fixed-source audit only. No module build, node start, identity read, authentication or network traffic performed.

findings.requirement: owned cancellable streams across five platforms
findings.observed: fixed libtailscale uses Unix Socketpair/SCM_RIGHTS and TsnetDial(context.Background); existing compile probe only imports tsnet, it does not compile or validate this fd shim
findings.next: implement portable opaque net.Conn handles with per-operation contexts and bounded ownership; no system TCP fallback

findings.observed: tsnet Store defaults to FileStore if nil; StateStore is concurrent, missing returns ErrStateNotExist, nil WriteState deletes; custom Store still requires a distinct root directory
findings.next: provide mandatory encrypted native-only StateStore; do not reuse EasyTier's single network-secret envelope as complete Tailscale state

findings.observed: fixed getAuthKey falls back to TS_AUTHKEY and other auth sources when Server.AuthKey absent
findings.next: explicit auth policy must prevent ambient credential fallback without reading real environment values; bounded interactive login state must be distinct from Running

findings.observed: Dial calls Start implicitly; Close documented not before or concurrent with Start; Up may wait through NeedsLogin or NeedsMachineAuth
findings.next: serialize managed Start/Close, preserve late-start cleanup ownership, bound readiness independently from local engine start

findings.requirement: no unsanitized native logs or remote upload
findings.observed: Heeler disables log upload inside Go runtime via envknob and logtail; C setenv after Go initialization is insufficient; UserLogf may contain login URL
findings.next: disable upload before first node and expose only explicitly reviewed auth state, not raw logs
